bifrost: springboard/render/src/gfx.rs (CPU blur), springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs (GPU dual-Kawase blur pyramid), springboard/render/src/gfx/rotate.rs (bilinear resample), springboard/render/src/emoji.rs (area and bilinear resample), springboard/src/gpu/egl.rs (EGL/GLES compute and render path); springboard/sdk/src/image_ops.rs; springboard/sdk/src/nn_graph.rs
summary: BifrOSt has a GPU blur pyramid and bilinear resampling, both used internally by the shell for glass and scaling. It exposes no app-facing GPU image-filter, histogram, matrix or neural-network API, and only a unary kernel base trait with a chain runner (springboard/render/src/kernel.rs), not a Metal-style kernel layer; most of the framework has no counterpart. Wave 15 (2026-10-19) adds app-facing kernels over app Images in sdk image_ops (colour convolution, scaling, statistics, integral images, reductions, arithmetic, pyramids, distance transform, guided filter, keypoints, a storable kernel chain) and sdk nn_graph (a node graph with a model file, sequence layers, batch inference). CPU only; no GPU dispatch.

features.feature: Kernel base classes and keyed archiving
features.apple: MPSKernel, MPSUnaryImageKernel, MPSBinaryImageKernel, NSKeyedArchiver with MPSKeyedUnarchiver
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/image_kernels.rs (ImageKernel, apply_chain), springboard/ui/src/cnn_layers.rs; tests: springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-22.rs; springboard/sdk/src/image_ops.rs (KernelSpec, encode_kernels, decode_kernels, run_chain)
features.note: An app defines a kernel by implementing ImageKernel with its class, the built-in kernels implement it too, and apply_chain runs kernels in order; all tested headless. Gap: there is no GPU kernel dispatch, no keyed archiving of kernels, and the code is not wired into the shell or apps. Built 2026-10-19: image_ops::KernelSpec is a value that implements ImageKernel (so apply_chain runs it with the built-in kernels); encode_kernels and decode_kernels store and restore a chain as text (header, one kernel per line). The reader refuses a wrong header, unknown kernels, wrong argument counts, non-finite numbers, oversized sides, lines above 4096 bytes and more than 256 kernels. The format is ours, not Apple's keyed archive. Still a gap: no GPU kernel dispatch. Midget check: run `cargo test --offline -p bifrost-app image_ops::tests` on the Midget build host and see every test pass (a_kernel_chain_round_trips_through_the_archive, a_restored_chain_gives_the_same_pixels, hostile_archives_are_refused); there is no app UI for it yet, so no click path.

gaps: No app-facing GPU compute or image-filter API. The GPU path (springboard/src/gpu/) serves the shell only.

No app-facing convolution with a caller kernel and no app-facing image statistics; plane_stats is shell-side. Histogram, threshold, morphology, median, Sobel and Laplacian are app-facing in sdk pixel_filter (2026-10-17).

No graph object and no GPU path for neural network layers. CPU layers exist (ui cnn_layers: convolution, pooling, dense, relu, LSTM and GRU steps; sdk core_ml: dense, relu and softmax models), but apps cannot build a graph or serialise a model beyond its text form.
No GPU matrix or linear algebra kernels. CPU vector, matrix and quaternion types are in sdk linear_algebra.
Resampling is bilinear or area-average in the shell. Lanczos is the LanczosScale kernel in ui image_kernels, with no sdk resample call.
